runs.speech_note: Speech-event instrumentation was added only for second run; absence of log lines does not mean no speech.

scope: First run used superseded loss/reacquisition speech policy and produced user-reported chatter. Second run uses quiet policy. Counts are software events, not proof the user heard them. No ground-truth tracking labels or tape-measured distances.
policy: Position speech once/session; loss speech at most once/session after 5s (10s before acquisition); two consecutive detections; silence on stale/missing results; beep interval >=1s.
final_live_limit: Quiet-policy run had no confirmed target and no tracking beeps; confirms only one not-found speech request, not successful final live tracking.
